payments_deposits_empty_sub: Transfers to the shared USDT address that don't match any open payment land here for manual attribution.
login_sub: Sign in to manage FlashCash Global
coming_soon: This screen is part of the design and will be wired to the backend next.
exp_edit_sub: Record a business cost — salary, rent, internet, and more.
exp_err_amount: Amount must be greater than zero.
exp_err_other: Enter a label for the custom category.
rd_tier_hint: Tier sets the default discount ({{margin}}%) and balance limit.
rd_err_amount_positive: Enter an amount greater than zero.
rd_err_valid_price: Enter a valid price, or clear it to remove the override.
rd_pricing_hint: This reseller pays the lowest of: retail, the tier-margin price, the global per-variant override (edited in the product editor), and the “This reseller” custom price. The pencil edits the custom price for this reseller only; leave it empty to clear.
sup_sub: Upstream fulfillment suppliers — balance, health, mapped products, and catalog import.
sup_none_sub: Set a supplier credential (SUPPLIER_*_TOKEN / SUPPLIER_UMANAGE_KEY) to enable a supplier.
sup_check_now_tip: Check every product linked to this supplier now: record its costs, pause links that sell at a loss, hide / re-show products with its stock. Never changes a selling price.
sup_warn_body: It writes warnings under Alerts and doesn't change any product yet. Pausing a supplier that sells at a loss, switching to the next supplier, and taking out-of-stock products off sale are not turned on yet.
sup_live_body: It pauses a supplier that would sell at a loss, sends orders to the next supplier, and takes a product off sale when no supplier has it (and back on when one does). It never changes your prices.
sup_off_body: “Check now” on a supplier checks its products once.
sup_alerts_empty_sub: You don't add alerts here — they appear by themselves when a supplier changes its price, a product would sell at a loss, a product runs out at every supplier, or an order can't be sent to any supplier.
sup_warning_only_tip: Nothing was changed: automatic changes are not turned on yet.
sup_msg_cost_changed: {{product}}: {{supplier}} cost {{per}} moved {{old}} → {{new}} ({{pct}}%). Selling price unchanged — review it.
sup_msg_loss_would: {{product}}: {{supplier}} now costs {{cost}} {{per}} but we sell at {{sell}} — that is a loss.
sup_msg_loss: {{product}}: {{supplier}} now costs {{cost}} {{per}} but we sell at {{sell}} — link paused.
sup_msg_loss_backup_would: This supplier would be paused (it is only a backup, so orders are not affected).
sup_msg_loss_backup: It stays as a backup only while paused.
sup_msg_loss_offsale_would: No other supplier can take it, so the product would be taken off sale until the cost drops or you change the price.
sup_msg_loss_offsale: No other supplier can take it — the product is hidden until the cost recovers or you change the price.
sup_msg_recovered_would: {{product}}: {{supplier}} is profitable again (cost {{cost}}, we sell at {{sell}} {{per}}) — it would be unpaused. Nothing was changed.
sup_msg_recovered: {{product}}: {{supplier}} is profitable again (cost {{cost}}, we sell at {{sell}} {{per}}) — unpaused. The active supplier was not switched back.
sup_reason_unavailable: no linked supplier has it available
sup_reason_loss: every supplier that has it costs at least our selling price
sup_msg_hidden_would: {{product}} would be taken off sale: {{reason}}. Nothing was changed — it is still on sale.
sup_msg_hidden: {{product}} was taken off sale: {{reason}}. It comes back by itself when that changes.
sup_msg_shown_would: {{product}} would go back on sale: a linked supplier has it again.
sup_msg_shown: {{product}} is back on sale: a linked supplier has it again.
sup_msg_fx_missing: {{supplier}} prices are in {{currencies}} but no USD exchange rate is set, so the loss check is skipped for {{n}} linked product(s). Set the rate in Suppliers → Settings.
sup_msg_fallback_exhausted: Order {{order}} ({{product}}): supplier {{from}} refused it and no other linked supplier can take it ({{reason}}). It keeps retrying — send it to another supplier or fulfil it by hand.
sup_catalog_error: The supplier catalog is unavailable (check balance/health).
sup_orders_empty_sub: Orders fulfilled through this supplier will appear here.
sup_fx_hint: The automatic supplier check uses this rate to compare this supplier's prices with yours (to spot selling at a loss). Empty = no loss check for {{name}}.
sup_toast_check_err: Could not check this supplier's products
prod_issue_dup_key: Duplicate field key "{{key}}" — keys must be unique.
prod_issue_min_nan: Field "{{name}}": min is not a number.
prod_issue_max_nan: Field "{{name}}": max is not a number.
prod_issue_select_empty: Field "{{name}}": a select needs at least one option.
prod_unit_issue_block: Per-unit pricing: set how many units the price is for (above 0).
prod_unit_issue_price: Per-unit pricing: set a customer price above 0.
prod_unit_issue_no_amount: Per-unit pricing: add an input field of type "amount" for the customer to type the amount.
prod_unit_issue_range: Per-unit pricing: the amount field "{{key}}" needs a min above 0 and a max ≥ min.
prod_unit_issue_qty: Per-unit pricing: remove the quantity field "{{key}}" — per-unit products are bought by amount.
prod_link_issue_none: Link at least one supplier product, or untick "Fulfill via supplier API".
prod_confirm_delete_one: Move {{n}} product to the trash? Customers won't see or be able to buy them until you restore them from the Deleted view.
prod_confirm_delete_other: Move {{n}} products to the trash? Customers won't see or be able to buy them until you restore them from the Deleted view.
prod_confirm_delete_all_one: Move all {{n}} product matching the current filters to the trash? Customers won't see or be able to buy them until you restore them from the Deleted view.
prod_confirm_delete_all_other: Move all {{n}} products matching the current filters to the trash? Customers won't see or be able to buy them until you restore them from the Deleted view.
prod_confirm_purge_one: Permanently delete {{n}} product? This erases them for good and cannot be undone. Past orders keep their own copy of the product.
prod_confirm_purge_other: Permanently delete {{n}} products? This erases them for good and cannot be undone. Past orders keep their own copy of the product.
prod_confirm_purge_all_one: Permanently delete all {{n}} product matching the current filters? This erases them for good and cannot be undone. Past orders keep their own copy of the product.
prod_confirm_purge_all_other: Permanently delete all {{n}} products matching the current filters? This erases them for good and cannot be undone. Past orders keep their own copy of the product.
prod_confirm_restore_all_one: Restore all {{n}} product matching the current filters? Each goes back to its previous status (active or draft).
prod_confirm_restore_all_other: Restore all {{n}} products matching the current filters? Each goes back to its previous status (active or draft).
prod_confirm_activate_all_one: Activate all {{n}} product matching the current filters? Customers will see them.
prod_confirm_activate_all_other: Activate all {{n}} products matching the current filters? Customers will see them.
prod_confirm_deactivate_all_one: Deactivate all {{n}} product matching the current filters? Customers won't see them.
prod_confirm_deactivate_all_other: Deactivate all {{n}} products matching the current filters? Customers won't see them.
prod_ff_code_desc: Gift cards, keys, vouchers — delivered instantly from inventory.
prod_ff_credit_desc: Game / app top-ups credited to a player ID — no code.
prod_ff_transfer_desc: Service flow with a status timeline & manual steps.
prod_unit_removed_qty_one: Removed the quantity field {{fields}} — per-unit products are bought by amount.
prod_unit_removed_qty_other: Removed the quantity fields {{fields}} — per-unit products are bought by amount.
prod_api_hint: Orders are placed automatically at the selected wholesale supplier and paid from its prepaid balance. Input-field keys must match the supplier's parameter names.
prod_fallback_hint: When the active supplier refuses an order for sure (no balance, product withdrawn, throttled, maintenance…), the order goes to the next switched-on supplier in this list by itself. It never moves an order a supplier may still deliver, or one an admin sent by hand.
prod_api_amount_warn: This product asks for an amount but has a fixed price. Turn on per-unit pricing so the price and the quantity sent to the supplier follow the amount — the server refuses to save it otherwise.
prod_no_suppliers: No suppliers configured — set <c>SUPPLIER_*_TOKEN</c> on the API (or <c>FULFILLMENT_MOCK=true</c> in dev). Orders will park for manual completion until one is.
prod_img_too_big: Image must be 10 MB or smaller.
prod_img_bad_type: Image must be JPEG, PNG, or WebP.
prod_mt_need_currencies: Exchange rates need both a base and a quote currency.
prod_mt_need_rate: Set at least one of the buy or sell rate.
prod_mt_min_max: Minimum amount cannot exceed the maximum.
prod_trash_banner: In trash: customers can't see or buy this product. You can still edit it; restore it to put it back.
prod_title_hint: Localized titles shown to customers in each language.
prod_desc_ph: Describe the product, redemption steps, region…
prod_desc_hint: Localized description shown to customers in each language.
prod_cat_hint: Assign this product to a category so it appears in the app's browse tree (manage the tree under Categories).
prod_ff_hint: Determines how the product is delivered — this changes the fields below.
prod_ff_locked: Turn off the mobile-recharge bridge below to change the fulfillment type.
prod_mode_unit_hint_transfer: For transfers sold by amount: the customer types how much to send and pays the price below pro-rata (e.g. 1 unit at $1.00 → sending 1,000 costs $1,000).
prod_mode_unit_hint_credit: For coin/diamond recharges sold by amount: the customer types how many units they want and pays the price below pro-rata.
prod_mode_fixed_hint: The customer picks one of the packages below.
prod_dropped_pkgs_one: Saving will delete {{count}} other package ({{list}}) — per-unit products keep a single price. Switch back to Fixed packages to keep it.
prod_dropped_pkgs_other: Saving will delete {{count}} other packages ({{list}}) — per-unit products keep a single price. Switch back to Fixed packages to keep them.
prod_ignored_amounts: Customers type {{fields}} at checkout but pay the package price —
prod_ignored_fix_unit: switch to Per unit, or change the field type in Input fields below.
prod_ignored_fix_type: change the field type in Input fields below (Per unit isn’t available with the bridge or a supplier API).
prod_preview_hint: Set the price, the units it buys, and the amount field’s min/max (Input fields below) to see a preview.
prod_fields_hint: Fields the customer fills at checkout (e.g. Account ID, Zone ID, Email). Values are attached to the order for fulfillment. Keys must be unique. Sensitive fields are masked and never stored on the order. Constraints: quantity/amount take an optional min–max range; select takes the choices shown to the customer. quantity = how many packages the customer buys; amount = a number the customer types (it drives the price when Per unit pricing is on).
prod_fields_empty: No input fields — the customer enters nothing at checkout.
prod_code_hint: Manage the code pool that fulfills this product in Inventory. Low-stock alert fires below the threshold.
prod_credit_hint: Customers enter their player/account ID at checkout; top-ups are credited automatically via the provider API.
prod_bridge_hint: Fulfill this top-up automatically on a dual-SIM bridge phone (MTC Touch / Alfa) instead of the manual queue. Adds a phone field at checkout. Manage devices under Bridge.
prod_bridge_transfer_hint: Set each variant's Transfer amount above — the credit sent to the customer's line (distinct from the price they pay).
prod_bridge_scratch_hint: Scratch-card codes are claimed from this product's code Inventory — upload codes there, one applied per order.
prod_transfer_hint: Transfer orders use a manual status timeline (Submitted → Processing → Completed). No inventory or code pool is attached.
prod_rates_hint: Rates are quote-currency units per 1 base unit (e.g. 89,500 LBP per $1). Fill buy, sell, or both; leave everything blank for no rate board.
prod_verify_hint: When on, customers enter their game ID on the product page and must see the resolved nickname before they can buy — catching wrong IDs before payment. Best for account-credit top-ups (PUBG, Delta Force, …).
prod_verify_slug_hint: Must exactly match the ID Game Checker slug for this game (e.g. pubgm-global, dfm-garena). Add a text input field for the player ID too, so it shows at checkout.
prod_verify_need_slug: Enter a game slug, or turn verification off.
prod_status_on_hint: Visible in the storefront and purchasable.
prod_img_hint: JPEG, PNG, or WebP · max 10 MB · compressed to 1024px + 256px thumbnail.
prod_stock_hint: Bulk-upload codes in Inventory to grow the pool.
prod_cost_hint: Your cost per unit — used for inventory value, not shown to customers.
prod_confirm_trash_single: Move "{{name}}" to the trash? You can restore it from the Deleted view.
prod_trash_failed: Could not move the product to the trash.
prod_confirm_purge_single: Permanently delete "{{name}}"? This cannot be undone.
prod_purge_failed: Could not delete the product permanently.
prod_empty_sub: Try clearing filters or create a new product.
prod_ignored_badge_tip: Customers type {{fields}} but pay the fixed package price — open the product and switch to Per unit, or change the field type.
prod_links_autocheck_tip: Automatic supplier check: Price = warn about cost changes and pause when it sells at a loss; Stock = take the product off sale / back on with the supplier's stock
prod_q_unknown: not in the supplier's product list
prod_link_paused_tip: The automatic supplier check paused this link: it costs at least our selling price. It un-pauses by itself when the cost drops; making it active un-pauses it now.
prod_quotes_error: Couldn't load live supplier prices right now.
prod_links_hint: Orders go to the Active supplier. The order of the rows is the backup order. Auto-check: the automatic supplier check watches each ticked link's cost (warns you, pauses a link that sells at a loss) and stock (takes the product off sale when no supplier has it, back on when one does). It never changes your selling price.
prod_search_desc: Searches every connected supplier's product list. Link the same product at several suppliers — the order of the links is the order they're tried in.
prod_search_unavailable: couldn't load its product list right now
prod_search_none: No supplier sells a product matching “{{q}}”.
pick_error: Couldn't load this supplier's catalog — type the supplier product id above.
err_SUPPLIER_LINKS_CHANGED: someone else changed this product's suppliers — reload the page and try again
err_SUPPLIER_LINKS_MANAGED: this product's suppliers are managed in the supplier links table — reload the page to edit them
err_PRODUCT_NOT_DELETED: move the product to the trash before deleting it permanently
err_LINK_INVALID: The supplier links are not valid — check the list and try again.
err_LINK_UNKNOWN_SUPPLIER: One of the linked suppliers is not configured.
err_LINK_CATALOG_UNAVAILABLE: Couldn't load a supplier's product list to check the links — try again in a minute.
err_LINK_UPSTREAM_UNKNOWN: A linked product is not in that supplier's catalog — pick it from the supplier search.
ord_search_ph: Order ID, player ID, phone, email, name or code…
ord_resend_max: Re-send at most {{n}} orders at once
ord_resend_tip: Send the selected orders to a supplier again
ord_bulk_refund_confirm: Refund {{n}} order(s)? Wallet-paid orders are credited back — this cannot be undone.
ord_bulk_at_supplier: {{n}} skipped because a supplier may still deliver them — refund those from their own page.
ord_d_multi_accounts: This order credits {{n}} different accounts — credit every line below before completing.
ord_d_fail_hint: Stuck in pending (crashed mid-placement). Marking it failed moves no money — reverse any charge via the customer's wallet adjust.
ord_d_no_actions: No actions available for this order.
ord_d_codes_not_returned: Delivered codes are not returned to inventory.
ord_d_no_wallet: No wallet charge to reverse — this marks the order refunded.
ord_d_refund_irreversible: Delivered codes are not returned to inventory. This can't be undone.
ord_d_at_supplier_title: A supplier may still deliver this order.
ord_d_at_supplier_refund: If it does after the refund, the customer keeps both the money and the goods, and the supplier still charges us. Check the supplier's panel first.
ord_d_complete_body: Confirm the credit/transfer was delivered outside the platform. The order moves to completed and the customer sees it immediately.
ord_d_at_supplier_complete: It was sent to a supplier that hasn't finished with it. Completing it by hand can deliver it twice — check the supplier's panel first.
ord_d_fail_body: Clears a stuck pending order (crashed mid-placement). This moves the order to failed and does not move any money. If the wallet was charged, reverse it via the customer's wallet adjustment.
ord_sp_manual_body: This order is fulfilled by hand. You can send it to a connected supplier instead — they deliver it automatically and charge their prepaid balance.
ord_sp_earlier: Earlier attempts — if one of these suppliers still delivers, reconcile it manually.
ord_sp_t_refused: The supplier refused it — try another supplier or refund
ord_sp_via_body: The order is sent to the supplier you pick right away and completes automatically when they deliver.
ord_sp_to_body: The order is sent to the supplier you pick right away, as a new order there. The current supplier is no longer checked; its reference stays in the history.
ord_sp_cannot_send: This order can't be sent to a supplier.
ord_sp_product_missing: The product was deleted, so there is no supplier list — pick a supplier product below.
ord_sp_no_links: No supplier is linked to this product yet — link them in the product editor, or pick a supplier product below.
ord_sp_risk_manual: Make sure nobody has already credited this order by hand — otherwise the customer receives it twice and the supplier charges us.
ord_sp_risk_reroute: If the previous supplier still completes this order, the customer may receive it twice and both suppliers may charge us. Check the previous supplier's panel first when you can.
ord_sp_ack_at_supplier: The current supplier may still deliver this order — send it again anyway
ord_sp_ack_ambiguous: The previous supplier's result is unknown — send anyway
ord_sp_low_balance_ok: Send even if a supplier's balance looks too low (the account allows credit)
ord_br_body: Each order is placed again as a new supplier order, right away. Orders that are completed, refunded or not sendable are skipped.
ord_br_first_linked: Each order's first linked supplier (Active first, then the backup order)
ord_br_only_linked: {{name}} — only orders whose product is linked there
ord_br_hint_provider: Orders go to their product’s link at this supplier, even if it is the one they were sent to before.
ord_br_hint_first: Skips the supplier product each order was already sent to.
ord_br_risk_body: If a previous supplier still completes one of these orders, the customer may receive it twice and both suppliers may charge us.
ord_br_also_resend: Also re-send orders a supplier may still deliver (otherwise they are skipped)
ord_br_too_many: Select at most {{n}} orders — each one is a new, billed supplier order.
ord_msg_no_product_linked: no supplier product linked — link one in the product editor
ord_msg_list_unavailable: couldn't load this supplier's product list — try again in a minute
ord_msg_not_in_list: not in this supplier's product list any more
ord_msg_unavailable_now: unavailable at this supplier right now
ord_msg_switched_off: switched off in the product's supplier list
ord_msg_refused: the supplier refused it — try another supplier or refund
ord_msg_no_link: no linked supplier can take it — send it from the order page
ord_msg_no_link_because: no linked supplier can take it: {{why}}
ord_msg_link_no_product: that supplier link has no supplier product — link one in the product editor
ord_msg_upstream_unknown: product "{{id}}" is not in that supplier's catalog — pick the product from the list
ord_msg_qty_rejected: this order sends quantity {{n}}, which that supplier product doesn't accept
ord_msg_low_balance: that supplier's balance ({{balance}}) is below this order's cost ({{cost}}) — top it up, or confirm to send anyway
ord_msg_bulk_limit: re-send at most {{n}} orders at once
err_ORDER_AT_SUPPLIER: a supplier may still deliver this order — confirm to refund it anyway
err_REFUND_CREDIT_FAILED: the wallet credit failed; the order was left unrefunded — retry
err_REROUTE_NOT_PROCESSING: only orders that are still processing can be sent to a supplier
err_REROUTE_NOT_SUPPLIER_ORDER: only supplier orders and single-item account-credit orders can be sent to a supplier
err_REROUTE_AMBIGUOUS: the previous supplier's outcome is unknown and it may still deliver — confirm the double-delivery risk to continue
err_REROUTE_NEEDS_ACK: the current supplier may still deliver this order — confirm the double-delivery risk to send it again
err_REROUTE_BAD_QUANTITY: this order's quantity can't be sent to a supplier — complete or refund it by hand
err_REROUTE_UPSTREAM_REQUIRED: choose the supplier product to order
err_REROUTE_LINK_UNKNOWN: that supplier is no longer linked to the product — reload the order
err_REROUTE_LINK_DISABLED: that supplier is switched off in the product's supplier list — switch it on there first
err_REROUTE_CONFLICT: the order changed while you were rerouting it — reload and try again
err_REROUTE_CATALOG_UNAVAILABLE: couldn't load that supplier's product list to check the product — try again in a minute
err_REROUTE_UPSTREAM_UNKNOWN: that product is not in that supplier's catalog — pick the product from the list
err_REROUTE_UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE: that supplier marks this product unavailable right now — choose another supplier
err_REROUTE_QTY_REJECTED: that supplier product doesn't accept this order's quantity
err_REROUTE_LOW_BALANCE: that supplier's balance is below this order's cost — top it up, or confirm to send anyway
err_REROUTE_BULK_LIMIT: re-send at most 5 orders at once
tl_note_bridge_delivered: mobile recharge delivered by bridge device
tl_note_late_delivery: supplier delivered after the order was rerouted or left processing — reconcile manually
tl_note_rejected_backup_refunded: rejected by the backup supplier — refunded
tl_note_bridge_failed: mobile recharge failed on the device
tl_note_recharge_timeout: recharge timed out waiting for a device
tl_note_fallback: supplier {{from}} couldn't take the order — trying supplier #{{to}} automatically
tl_note_sent_another: sent to another supplier (#{{n}}) by admin
tl_note_sent_again: sent again to supplier (#{{n}}) by admin
tl_why_rerouted_no_line: rerouted order has no sendable supplier line
tl_why_status_unavailable: upstream status unavailable past give-up window
tl_why_still_waiting: still waiting upstream past give-up window
tl_why_no_line: retryable order has no sendable supplier line
brg_empty_sub: Register the dual-SIM phone that fulfills mobile recharges, then enter its token in the bridge app.
brg_remove_confirm: Remove {{name}}? Its token stops working immediately.
brg_cmd_empty_sub: Recharge orders enqueue commands here for the bridge device.
brg_token_hint: Copy this now — it's shown once and can't be retrieved later. Enter it in the bridge app on the device. To replace it, rotate the token.
inv_sub: Mission-critical — if codes run out, purchases fail.
inv_empty_sub: Code-type products will appear here once created.
inv_unpriced_tip: Products with no unit price set are excluded from this total.
inv_export_tip: Export this product's codes as CSV
inv_drop_title: Drop a CSV or TXT file of codes
inv_line_format_max: One code per line, or <m>code,pin</m> per line · max 50,000
inv_line_format: One code per line, or <m>code,pin</m> per line
inv_no_uploads: No uploads yet — bulk-uploaded code batches will appear here.
inv_enter_to_save: Edit a value and press Enter to save
inv_lookup_ph: Paste a code or last 4 digits…
inv_no_match_code_sub: Check the value and try again.
inv_lookup_hint: Look up a code to see its lifecycle.
inv_no_codes_sub: Add a code above or bulk-upload a batch.
inv_expire_tip: Retire this code from the available pool
inv_delete_body: <m>{{code}}</m> will be permanently removed from the pool. This can't be undone.
fin_sub: Money movement across the platform wallet ledger
fin_search_ph: Search by user or transaction ID…
fin_usdt_empty_sub: USDT wallet-funding requests appear here for verification once a customer declares an on-chain payment.
fin_reject_ph: e.g. no matching on-chain payment found…
top_reject_body: Reject the {{amount}} request from {{who}}. The reason is shown to the customer.
top_empty_sub: Customer wallet-funding requests appear here for approval after you receive their payment.
top_alert_new: New top-up request waiting for approval
top_methods_sub: Customer-facing wallet top-up options. Each is informational — a customer submits the inputs you define, then you approve the request in the Top-up queue to credit their wallet.
top_methods_empty_sub: Add one (e.g. Bank Transfer) with instructions and the inputs customers should submit.
top_method_delete_confirm: Delete "{{name}}"? Existing requests keep their record.
top_err_no_key: Couldn't derive a key for "{{label}}". Give it a manual key.
top_err_dup_key: Duplicate input key "{{key}}". Keys must be unique.
top_err_no_options: Dropdown "{{label}}" needs at least one option.
top_kind_hint: Controls where the method is offered: some app-store builds only show bank, cash and other methods, so set crypto and payment-app methods correctly.
top_instructions: Instructions (how the customer pays — e.g. the account to send to)
top_instructions_ph: Transfer to IBAN … then upload your receipt below.
top_no_inputs: No inputs — the customer just sees the instructions and submits the amount.
pay_empty_sub: On-chain USDT deposits (wallet top-ups and order payments) appear here as customers pay.
pay_err_user_required: A customer email or user id is required.
pay_attribute_body: Credit the {{amount}} deposit (tx {{hash}}) to a customer's wallet. This cannot be undone.
pay_attribute_ph: e.g. customer sent the base amount without the cents…
pay_ignore_body: Mark the {{amount}} deposit (tx {{hash}}) as ignored — no customer will be credited.
err_CODE_DUPLICATE: a code with this value already exists for this product
err_CODE_NOT_AVAILABLE: only available (undelivered) codes can be edited
err_CODE_DELIVERED: delivered codes cannot be deleted; expire them instead
err_LEDGER_WRITE_FAILED: the approval was reverted: the ledger row could not be written
err_USER_NOT_FOUND: no user matches that id or email
err_DEPOSIT_NOT_UNMATCHED: this deposit was already attributed or ignored
usr_sms_confirm: Send SMS to {{n}} user(s)? This sends real messages.
usr_sms_no_phone: Users without a phone number are skipped automatically.
usr_push_no_device: Users with no registered device are skipped automatically.
usr_delete_confirm: Delete this account? It is anonymized — email/phone are freed and it can no longer sign in, but its orders and ledger are kept. This cannot be undone.
usr_super_admin_option: Super Admin — full access, manages roles & admins
usr_roles_hint: Define roles under System → Roles. A permission change applies on the admin's next sign-in or session refresh.
usr_only_super: Only a super admin can grant or change admin access.
usr_pw_set: Password set — the user was signed out of all devices
usr_pw_min: Password must be at least {{n}} characters.
usr_pw_hint: The user is signed out of every device and must use the new password.
res_delete_tier_used: Delete the {{name}} tier? {{n}} reseller(s) are on it and will fall back to retail pricing until reassigned.
res_margin_hint: Resellers on this tier pay this % below retail on every product.
kyc_reject_body: Reject {{name}}'s verification. The reason is shown to the customer.
kyc_reason_ph: e.g. Date of birth doesn't match the document…
role_sub: Custom admin roles and what each one can see and do
role_super_desc: Built-in — full access, manages roles and admin accounts. Assigned by clearing an admin's role.
role_none: No custom roles yet — every admin is currently a Super Admin.
role_footer: Assign a role from a user's profile (Users → Role & access). Permission changes apply when the admin's session next refreshes (or on their next sign-in).
role_delete_body: A role that is still assigned to an admin cannot be deleted — reassign those accounts first.
role_perms_label: Permissions — view lets the role see an area, manage lets it act
set_sub: Store contact, loyalty program and admin accounts
set_support_email_hint: Shown on the public privacy-policy and account-deletion pages.
set_whatsapp_hint: Linked from the storefront help bot ("Still need help?"). Leave empty to hide.
set_pts_earn: Customers earn 1 point per ${{rate}} spent — points = order total ÷ rate, rounded down
set_pts_complete: Points are granted only when an order completes — instantly for code / inventory deliveries, and when you manually complete a top-up or transfer order. Pending, failed, or refunded orders earn nothing.
set_pts_future: Rate changes apply to future orders only; past orders keep the points they already earned.
set_pts_off: Turning the program off stops new earning — customers keep the points they already have.
set_err_earn_rate: Earn rate must be greater than zero.
set_err_support: Could not save the support contact.
set_rates_hint: Currency rates shown to customers on the top-up screen (e.g. Syrian pound, Egyptian pound). Both fields are free text and displayed exactly as typed. Leave the list empty to hide it.
set_err_rates_row: Each rate needs both a currency and a value.
set_ai_body: When on, customers can type questions in the Help Center and the AI answers them, using only the text in Help bot → AI knowledge. Each question is a small paid call, capped per customer and per day. When off, the Help Center shows only the support contacts.
set_ai_not_configured: No AI provider is configured on the server, so the assistant stays off for customers.
set_err_ai: Could not update the AI assistant setting.
set_2fa_body: When on, every admin login requires a one-time code sent by SMS after the password. Requires a phone number on your own admin account, and an admin without a phone will be blocked from signing in — set phones before enabling.
set_err_2fa: Could not update the two-factor setting.
set_admins_footer: Grant or revoke admin access from a user's profile (Users → role). Demoting or suspending the last remaining admin is blocked.
set_pw_min: New password must be at least {{n}} characters.
set_pw_mismatch: The new passwords do not match.
set_pw_same: Choose a password different from the current one.
set_pw_2fa_hint: For a second factor, turn on SMS two-factor under Security below.
err_LAST_ADMIN: cannot remove the last remaining super admin
err_BULK_SMS_LIMIT: too many recipients for one send — narrow the selection
err_BULK_PUSH_LIMIT: too many recipients for one send — narrow the selection
err_ADMIN_2FA_NO_PHONE: set a phone number on your admin account (and re-login) before enabling SMS two-factor authentication
err_ROLE_IN_USE: role is assigned to one or more admins — reassign them first
err_ROLE_NAME_TAKEN: a role with this name already exists
err_WEAK_PASSWORD: password must be at least 8 characters
err_PASSWORD_TOO_LONG: password must be at most 72 characters
err_NO_PASSWORD_SET: this account has no password yet — set one by signing in with an SMS code
cat_sub: Collections, categories and subcategories the app browses
cat_no_match: No collections or categories match your search.
cat_empty: No categories yet — create a Collection to get started.
cat_delete_body: A category with subcategories or assigned products can't be deleted — move or reassign them first.
cat_err_image_size: Image must be 10 MB or smaller.
cat_hint_with_children: Includes subcategories, listed A to Z. “Arrange order” sets the order of the products placed directly in this category; arrange each subcategory on its own row.
cat_hint_leaf: Listed in the order customers see.
cat_hint_count: The count reflects available products; drafts are listed here too. Assign products from the Products page (select rows → Move to category).
cat_assign_hint: Assign products from the Products page.
cat_arrange_hint: Customers see these products in this order, in the app and on the web. Drag a row by its handle or use the arrows. This arranges only the products placed directly in “{{name}}” — products in its subcategories are arranged on each subcategory. Products added later appear after the arranged ones, A to Z.
cat_none_direct: No products placed directly in this category.
cat_open_sub_hint: Open a subcategory and arrange its products there.
cat_srv_has_children: this category has subcategories — move or delete them first
cat_srv_has_products: products are assigned to this category — reassign them first
cat_srv_move_depth: move would exceed the maximum category depth (3 tiers)
cat_srv_own_descendant: cannot move a category under one of its own descendants
cat_srv_too_many: this category has more than 1000 products; split it into subcategories to arrange them
err_DUPLICATE: a category with the same identifier already exists
err_STALE_ORDER: The products in this category changed since you opened the list. Reload and arrange again.
dash_sub: Here's what's happening across FlashCash Global today — {{date}}.
dash_ff_note: Account-credit orders settle instantly — code orders depend on inventory.
dash_all_above: All products are above their stock thresholds.
promo_err_value: Value must be greater than zero.
promo_err_percent: Percent value must be between 0 and 100.
promo_err_dates: End date must be after the start date.
promo_srv_conflict: a promo with this code already exists
promo_new_sub: Create a discount or cashback campaign
promo_coming_soon: Per-user limits and category eligibility are coming soon.
promo_no_bound: Leave a date empty for no bound.
off_err_value: Discount value must be greater than zero.
off_new_sub: Put a product on a time-boxed sale price
off_need_products: Choosing a product needs Products access — ask a super admin to add Products (view) to your role.
off_sort_hint: Lower sort order shows first and wins when a product has more than one live offer.
off_pick_preview: Pick a product to preview the sale price.
err_OFFER_FIXED_UNIT_PRICED: this product is priced per unit — use a percentage discount instead of a fixed amount
cmp_toast_reply_sent: Reply sent — the customer was notified
cmp_search_ph: Number (C-1042), subject, phone, email or name…
cmp_empty_sub: Customer complaints submitted from the app or the website appear here.
cmp_note_ph: Internal note — only staff can see this
cmp_closed_ph: This complaint is closed. Reopen it to reply, or add an internal note.
cmp_reply_ph: Reply to the customer (they get an in-app notification)
cmp_status_hint: Resolved or closed notifies the customer. A customer reply reopens a resolved complaint.
err_THREAD_FULL: this complaint has reached its message limit; please open a new one
bot_sub: The Help Center's AI assistant: the knowledge it answers customers from, and what they asked. Turn it on or off in Settings.
bot_logs_empty_sub: AI questions appear here once customers use the assistant (kept for 30 days).
bot_toast_saved: Knowledge saved — the assistant uses it from the next question
bot_intro: Write what the assistant should know about the app, in plain words and in any language — it answers customers in their own language (English or Arabic). Leave a blank line between topics. It answers only from this text: anything not written here gets “contact support”, so never write prices or promises you don’t want repeated. See what customers ask in Conversations to find gaps.
bot_knowledge_hint: Shown to every customer, on Android and iOS.
bot_knowledge_ph:
How to buy: 1. Verify your identity once… 2. Top up your wallet…

Topping up the wallet: go to Wallet → Top up…
bot_android_hint: For game top-ups, player IDs, gift cards, crypto or money transfer. The iOS app sells phone recharges only (App Store rules), so it never gets this part.
err_KNOWLEDGE_TOO_LONG: the knowledge is too long — shorten it
todo_empty_sub: Add a task above — every admin sees the same list.
todo_delete_note: Every admin shares this list. The deletion is recorded in the activity log.
rev_delete_body: Delete this review by {{user}} on {{product}}? This cannot be undone.
aud_empty_sub: Admin actions (role changes, wallet adjustments, refunds, moderation decisions) appear here.
login_code_resent: A new code has been sent.
login_2fa_body: Enter the 6-digit code sent by SMS to {{phone}}.
err_OTP_THROTTLED: please wait before requesting another code
err_OTP_EXPIRED: this code has expired, request a new one
err_OTP_LOCKED: too many attempts, request a new code
err_RATE_LIMITED: too many requests — please slow down and try again shortly
err_forbidden: This account is not an administrator.
err_no_challenge: No verification in progress — sign in again.
cmn_nf_sub: The screen you're looking for doesn't exist.
pick_warn_not_found: "{{id}}" is not in this supplier's catalog — the supplier will refuse it (Product Not Found).
pick_warn_unavailable: The supplier marks this product unavailable right now.
pick_warn_qty: This order sends quantity {{n}}, but the supplier accepts {{range}}.
pick_warn_params: The supplier asks for {{names}}, which this order doesn't carry by that name — check the supplier won't refuse it.
pick_warn_amount: Customers may type {{min}}–{{max}}, but the supplier accepts {{range}} — narrow the amount field's min/max.
